title: Clair - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Clair in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Half of the Clair and Obscur pair. It is immune to Light and weak to Dark - the exact inverse of Obscur.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toDark
ResistsNone
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneLight

Bring Dark damage. Light does nothing at all.

sections.title: How to Beat the Clair
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Dark is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It is immune to Light, which will do nothing at all.
